from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    best=None
    for col in cnt:
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==col]
        if not cells: continue
        a=min(i for i,_ in cells); b=min(j for _,j in cells)
        a2=max(i for i,_ in cells); b2=max(j for _,j in cells)
        if len(cells)==(a2-a+1)*(b2-b+1):
            # breaks vertical symmetry: cell equals its mirror only if mirror also col
            breaks=any(g[H-1-i][j]!=col for i,j in cells)
            if breaks and (best is None or cnt[col]<cnt[best]):
                best=col; box=(a,b,a2,b2)
    a,b,a2,b2=box
    return [[g[H-1-(a+i)][b+j] for j in range(b,b2+1)] for i in range(a,a2+1)]
print(transform(gi)==go)
out=transform(G['Test input'])
for r in out: print(r)
print(json.dumps(out))
